text: Data on venture capital investments lets regulators see where innovation trends are forming and what risks they entail before the disruptive innovation materializes, which is the specific remedy for regulation's reactive timing.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2740477

isBasedOn.name: Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation

abstract: Data on VC investments allows regulators to see where innovation trends exist and what possible risks are entailed before disruptive innovation materializes.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: regulators have access to and integrate venture capital investment data
